name: salesforce-to-client-cloud
description: Moves a Salesforce application to the client's cloud in six transformation phases (Discover, Design, Build, Migrate, Validate, Go-live), with a review gate after each phase. Each agent lives in its own folder (agent.json + index.js).

phases.title: Go-live
phases.note: Approved changes are committed and pushed to main; the pipeline re-runs the checks and deploys.
